description: 20 real football transfer rumours from 2022-2024. ground_truth TRUE = later confirmed; FALSE = never materialised. The FALSE rumours (R11-R20) are deliberately phrased with a FEE or WINDOW that contradicts the knowledge base (release clauses / transfer-window rules), so the Layered-RAG can REFUTE them - not just confirm true ones.

rumors.text: Kylian Mbappe has completed his free transfer to Real Madrid after his PSG contract expired.
Jude Bellingham joins Real Madrid from Borussia Dortmund for an initial GBP 88.5m.
Harry Kane signs for Bayern Munich in a GBP 100m deal from Tottenham.
Declan Rice completes a GBP 105m move from West Ham to Arsenal.
Chelsea agree a British-record GBP 115m fee for Moises Caicedo from Brighton.
Liverpool sign Dominik Szoboszlai from RB Leipzig for GBP 60m, triggering his release clause.
Manchester City complete the signing of Erling Haaland from Borussia Dortmund for his GBP 51m release clause.
Lionel Messi joins Inter Miami on a free transfer from Paris Saint-Germain.
Cristiano Ronaldo signs for Saudi club Al Nassr on a free transfer.
Neymar leaves PSG for Al Hilal in a EUR 90m deal to the Saudi Pro League.
Barcelona wonderkid Gavi is set to join Manchester United for GBP 80m this summer.
Newcastle are close to signing Enzo Fernandez from Benfica for GBP 60m.
Arsenal agree a GBP 50m deal for Antoine Griezmann from Atletico Madrid.
Al Hilal are in talks to sign Karim Benzema from Real Madrid for GBP 40m.
Liverpool want to sign Joao Felix from Benfica for GBP 70m.
Manchester City will sign Ruben Dias from Benfica for GBP 30m.
Liverpool are pushing for Aurelien Tchouameni from Monaco for GBP 50m.
Manchester United will sign Dominik Szoboszlai from RB Leipzig for GBP 40m.
Arsenal target Christopher Nkunku from Leipzig for GBP 45m.
Real Madrid will sign Kylian Mbappe in the November transfer window for GBP 30m.
